title: Establish a foreign subsidiary or branch
summary: When operating in another country requires a reviewed legal presence rather than remote sales alone. An approved local structure with completed registrations, operating authority and owned intercompany obligations.
outcomes: An approved local structure with completed registrations, operating authority and owned intercompany obligations.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When operating in another country requires a reviewed legal presence rather than remote sales alone.

parts.title: Describe the intended foreign operation
parts.guidance: Record activities, customers, personnel, premises, management, funds and data flows. Identify the proposed start date and distinguish a subsidiary, branch, representative office and distributor arrangement.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Select the structure with local advisers
parts.guidance: Qualified legal and tax advisers assess the actual commercial need, local rules, permanent-establishment exposure, ownership and reporting. Compare alternatives and document assumptions before approving a local entity.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Select the structure with local advisers

parts.title: Prepare formation and operating dependencies
parts.guidance: Assemble approved ownership, director, address, capital and identification records. Plan tax, payroll, banking, licensing and intercompany arrangements with owners for prerequisites.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize and complete the local establishment
parts.guidance: Authorized representatives execute the reviewed documents and local advisers coordinate submissions. Retain official decisions and keep restricted activities paused until required registrations or permissions are obtained.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Authorize and complete the local establishment

parts.title: Reconcile local and group operations
parts.guidance: Verify the local register, bank mandates, accounting, payroll and permissions against the approved plan. Activate the reporting calendar and transfer-pricing review and retain unresolved obligations with owners.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved local structure with completed registrations, operating authority and owned intercompany obligations.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
